summary: Jaria Jaug, a nonpartisan incumbent on the Berryessa Union School District governing board in California, carries a full general-election endorsement from CAIR Action and an Ally rating from Vote for Peace. Both organizations evaluate candidates on Gaza, civil-rights, and war-lobby-funding positions, making their directional recommendations concrete indicators of Jaug's stance on Palestinian justice.
